binding_design_decisions.statement: Semantic adjudication is the only authoritative final-label path. An automatic parser may triage, route or diagnose, but may never be the final correctness label for a scientific result.
binding_design_decisions.source: paper/limitations_ledger.md L-01, elevated from a temporary limitation to a project design rule

binding_design_decisions.statement: The parser-v3-v1 and parser-v3-v2 locked-evaluation programs are closed. No new private holdout, set repair, private review boundary, Stage P/E run, parser freeze or parser audit is authorized.

All old reports, receipts, commits, failed candidates, sealed objects, counters and audit findings are preserved unchanged. BLOCKED_ON_PUBLIC_PROTOCOL_FREEZE remains the correct terminal state of the parser subproject under its old authority.
The old parser terminal state is not a global scientific-project blocker.

Existing parser-v3 code, tests, schemas, entrypoints, IaC and audit tooling remain historical/methodological artifacts. They are not deleted, not improved and not re-audited under this authority, and elaborateness alone does not make them publishable.
A negative headroom result, a non-converged lens or a failed validity gate is a scientific result, not a reason to create another evaluator or audit-infrastructure project.
